chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Bilal al-Muhallabi - may Allah have mercy on him - reported to us on Friday, with two nights remaining of Sha'ban in the year three hundred and fifty-three. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Humayd ibn al-Rabi al-Lakhmi reported to us. He said: Sulayman ibn al-Rabi al-Nahdi reported to us. He said: Nasr ibn Muzahim al-Minqari reported to us. He said: Yahya ibn Ya'la al-Aslami reported to us, from Ali ibn al-Huzawwar, from al-Asbagh ibn Nubata - may Allah have mercy on him - who said:

A man came to the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), at Basra and said: 'O Commander of the Faithful, between us and these people against whom we fight, the call is one, the Messenger is one, the prayer is one, and the Hajj is one - so how shall we classify them?'
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said to him: 'Classify them as Allah, Mighty and Majestic, classified them in His Book. Have you not heard the Most High say:'

Those messengers - We favored some of them above others. Among them is he to whom Allah spoke, and He raised some of them in degrees. And We gave Jesus the son of Mary the clear signs and strengthened him with the Holy Spirit. And if Allah had willed, those who came after them would not have fought one another after the clear signs had come to them, but they differed - and among them were those who believed and among them were those who disbelieved.

So when the disagreement occurred, we were more worthy with Allah, with His religion, with the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family and grant him peace), with the Book, and with the Truth. We are those who believed, and they are those who disbelieved. And Allah willed from us to fight them, so we fought them by His will, His command, and His pleasure.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful - title of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS)
key_terms.الِاخْتِلَافُ: The disagreement - the political-religious schism after the Prophet’s death leading to the Battle of Jamal
key_terms.الْبَيِّنَاتِ: The clear signs - manifest proofs and miracles given to the prophets
key_terms.الْحَقِّ: The Truth - righteousness and divine justice that Ali claimed to represent
key_terms.رُوحِ الْقُدُسِ: The Holy Spirit (Ruh al-Qudus) - the divine spirit that supported Prophet Jesus (AS)

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali justify fighting fellow Muslims at the Battle of Jamal using the Quran?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) responds to a man's question in Basra about how to classify the opposing side at the Battle of Jamal, given that both groups share the same religion. Ali directs him to the Quran (2:253), which describes how even after the messengers, people differed and some believed while others disbelieved. He concludes that his followers are the believers and the opponents are the disbelievers, and that their fight was carried out by God's will and command.
